out.title: Anup Bagchi takes charge as HDFC Bank MD & CEO
out.summary: Sashidhar Jagdishan vacated MD & CEO office on October 26, 2026 on tenure completion; Anup Bagchi assumed charge effective October 27, 2026. Detailed disclosures were provided in the October 1, 2026 intimation.

person.name: Anup Bagchi
person.role: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer
person.bio: Assumed charge as MD & CEO of HDFC Bank effective October 27, 2026; detailed Regulation 30 disclosures were provided in the Bank's intimation dated October 1, 2026.
